basic_info.description: Welcome to 130 Bridgeview Dr., a turnkey Midcentury home in the heart of Silver Terrace. This renovated four-bedroom, three-bath home offers space, light, and the dream floor plan. The sun-filled main level features a formal living room with fireplace, hardwood floors and oversized windows framing views of downtown, the Bay Bridge, and the East Bay Hills. The space opens to a large updated kitchen an adjoining dining area. Three bedrooms and two baths, including a primary suite, complete this level. The lower level provides an additional bedroom with an ensuite bath, a kitchenette, and a family room with doors that open to a large entertaining deck. Silver Terrace itself is a sunny enclave, offering tranquil residential streets with nearby parks, schools and amenities. Minutes to San Bruno Ave., Bernal Heights, McLaren Park, the Alemany Farmer's Market and easy freeway access make this location ideal for both city living and commuters.
